AccessControlBadConfirmation().details: The caller of a function is not the expected one. NOTE: Don't confuse with {AccessControlUnauthorizedAccount}.

ECDSAInvalidSignatureLength(uint256).details: The signature has an invalid length.

ECDSAInvalidSignatureS(bytes32).details: The signature has an S value that is in the upper half order.

ERC20InsufficientAllowance(address,uint2.details: Indicates a failure with the `spender`’s `allowance`. Used in transfers.

params.allowance: Amount of tokens a `spender` is allowed to operate with.
params.needed: Minimum amount required to perform a transfer.
params.spender: Address that may be allowed to operate on tokens without being their owner.

ERC20InsufficientBalance(address,uint256.details: Indicates an error related to the current `balance` of a `sender`. Used in transfers.

params.balance: Current balance for the interacting account.
params.needed: Minimum amount required to perform a transfer.
params.sender: Address whose tokens are being transferred.

ERC20InvalidApprover(address).details: Indicates a failure with the `approver` of a token to be approved. Used in approvals.

ERC20InvalidReceiver(address).details: Indicates a failure with the token `receiver`. Used in transfers.

params.receiver: Address to which tokens are being transferred.

ERC20InvalidSender(address).details: Indicates a failure with the token `sender`. Used in transfers.

params.sender: Address whose tokens are being transferred.

ERC20InvalidSpender(address).details: Indicates a failure with the `spender` to be approved. Used in approvals.

params.spender: Address that may be allowed to operate on tokens without being their owner.

EnforcedPause().details: The operation failed because the contract is paused.

ExpectedPause().details: The operation failed because the contract is not paused.

InvalidAccountNonce(address,uint256).details: The nonce used for an `account` is not the expected current nonce.

SafeERC20FailedOperation(address).details: An operation with an ERC-20 token failed.

Approval(address,address,uint256).details: Emitted when the allowance of a `spender` for an `owner` is set by a call to {approve}. `value` is the new allowance.

EIP712DomainChanged().details: MAY be emitted to signal that the domain could have changed.

Initialized(uint64).details: Triggered when the contract has been initialized or reinitialized.

Paused(address).details: Emitted when the pause is triggered by `account`.

RoleAdminChanged(bytes32,bytes32,bytes32.details: Emitted when `newAdminRole` is set as ``role``'s admin role, replacing `previousAdminRole` `DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE` is the starting admin for all roles, despite {RoleAdminChanged} not being emitted signaling this.

RoleGranted(bytes32,address,address).details: Emitted when `account` is granted `role`. `sender` is the account that originated the contract call. This account bears the admin role (for the granted role). Expected in cases where the role was granted using the internal {AccessControl-_grantRole}.

RoleRevoked(bytes32,address,address).details: Emitted when `account` is revoked `role`. `sender` is the account that originated the contract call:   - if using `revokeRole`, it is the admin role bearer   - if using `renounceRole`, it is the role bearer (i.e. `account`)

Transfer(address,address,uint256).details: Emitted when `value` tokens are moved from one account (`from`) to another (`to`). Note that `value` may be zero.

Unpaused(address).details: Emitted when the pause is lifted by `account`.

DOMAIN_SEPARATOR().details: Returns the domain separator used in the encoding of the signature for {permit}, as defined by {EIP712}.

convertToAssets(uint256).details: vbToken is backed by the underlying token 1:1.

depositAndBridge(uint256,address,uint32,.details: If vbToken is custom mapped on LxLy Bridge on the other network, the user will receive Custom Token. Otherwise, they will receive wrapped vbToken.The `receiver` in the ERC-4626 `Deposit` event will be this contract.

depositWithPermit(uint256,address,bytes).details: Uses EIP-2612 permit to transfer the underlying token from the sender to self.

depositWithPermitAndBridge(uint256,addre.details: If vbToken is custom mapped on LxLy Bridge on the other network, the user will receive Custom Token. Otherwise, they will receive wrapped vbToken.Uses EIP-2612 permit to transfer the underlying token from the sender to self.The `receiver` in the ERC-4626 `Deposit` event will be this contract.

getRoleAdmin(bytes32).details: Returns the admin role that controls `role`. See {grantRole} and {revokeRole}. To change a role's admin, use {_setRoleAdmin}.

grantRole(bytes32,address).details: Grants `role` to `account`. If `account` had not been already granted `role`, emits a {RoleGranted} event. Requirements: - the caller must have ``role``'s admin role. May emit a {RoleGranted} event.

name().details: Returns the name of the token.

nonces(address).details: Returns the current nonce for `owner`. This value must be included whenever a signature is generated for {permit}. Every successful call to {permit} increases ``owner``'s nonce by one. This prevents a signature from being used multiple times.

paused().details: Returns true if the contract is paused, and false otherwise.

renounceRole(bytes32,address).details: Revokes `role` from the calling account. Roles are often managed via {grantRole} and {revokeRole}: this function's purpose is to provide a mechanism for accounts to lose their privileges if they are compromised (such as when a trusted device is misplaced). If the calling account had been revoked `role`, emits a {RoleRevoked} event. Requirements: - the caller must be `callerConfirmation`. May emit a {RoleRevoked} event.

revokeRole(bytes32,address).details: Revokes `role` from `account`. If `account` had been granted `role`, emits a {RoleRevoked} event. Requirements: - the caller must have ``role``'s admin role. May emit a {RoleRevoked} event.

symbol().details: Returns the symbol of the token, usually a shorter version of the name.

asset().notice: The underlying token that backs vbToken.

backingDifference().notice: The real-time difference between the total assets and the minimum assets required to back the total supply of vbToken.

claimAndRedeem(bytes32[32],bytes32[32],u.notice: Claim vbToken from LxLy Bridge and redeem it.

convertToAssets(uint256).notice: Tells how much a specific amount of vbToken is worth in the underlying token.

convertToShares(uint256).notice: Tells how much a specific amount of underlying token is worth in vbToken.

decimals().notice: The number of decimals of the vault bridge token.The number of decimals is the same as that of the underlying token, or 18 if the underlying token reverted (e.g., does not implement `decimals`).

deposit(uint256,address).notice: Deposit a specific amount of the underlying token and mint vbToken.

depositAndBridge(uint256,address,uint32,.notice: Deposit a specific amount of the underlying token, and bridge minted vbToken to another network.

depositWithPermit(uint256,address,bytes).notice: Deposit a specific amount of the underlying token and mint vbToken.

depositWithPermitAndBridge(uint256,addre.notice: Deposit a specific amount of the underlying token, and bridge minted vbToken to another network.

lxlyBridge().notice: LxLy Bridge, which connects AggLayer networks.

lxlyId().notice: The LxLy ID of this network.

maxDeposit(address).notice: How much underlying token can deposited for a specific user right now. (Depositing the underlying token mints vbToken).

maxMint(address).notice: How much vbToken can be minted to a specific user right now. (Minting vbToken locks the underlying token).

maxRedeem(address).notice: How much vbToken can be redeemed for a specific user. (Redeeming vbToken burns it and unlocks the underlying token).

maxWithdraw(address).notice: How much underlying token can be withdrawn from a specific user right now. (Withdrawing the underlying token burns vbToken).

migrationFeesFund().notice: A dedicated fund for covering the underlying token's transfer fees during a migration from a Layer Y. Please refer to `_completeMigration` for more information.

minimumReservePercentage().notice: Vault bridge tokens have an internal reserve of the underlying token from which withdrawals are served first.The owner can rebalance the reserve by calling `rebalanceReserve` when it is below or above the `minimumReservePercentage`.

minimumYieldVaultDeposit().notice: The minimum deposit amount for triggering a yield vault deposit.Amounts below this value will be reserved regardless of the reserve percentage, in order to save gas for the user.The limit does not apply when rebalancing the reserve.

mint(uint256,address).notice: Mint a specific amount of vbToken by locking the required amount of the underlying token.

previewDeposit(uint256).notice: How much vbToken would be minted if a specific amount of the underlying token were deposited right now.

previewMint(uint256).notice: How much underlying token would be required to mint a specific amount of vbToken right now.

previewRedeem(uint256).notice: How much underlying token would be unlocked if a specific amount of vbToken were redeemed and burned right now.

previewWithdraw(uint256).notice: How much vbToken would be burned if a specific amount of the underlying token were withdrawn right now.

redeem(uint256,address,address).notice: Burn a specific amount of vbToken and unlock the respective amount of the underlying token.

reservePercentage().notice: The real-time reserve percentage.The reserve is based on the total supply of vbToken, and does not account for uncompleted migrations of backing from Layer Ys to Layer X. Please refer to `completeMigration` for more information.

reservedAssets().notice: Vault bridge tokens have an internal reserve of the underlying token from which withdrawals are served first.The owner can rebalance the reserve by calling `rebalanceReserve` when it is below or above the `minimumReservePercentage`.

stakedAssets().notice: The real-time amount of the underlying token in the yield vault, as reported by the yield vault.

totalAssets().notice: The real-time total backing of vbToken in the underlying token.

underlyingToken().notice: The underlying token that backs vbToken.

withdraw(uint256,address,address).notice: Withdraw a specific amount of the underlying token by burning the required amount of vbToken.

yield().notice: The real-time amount of yield available for collection.

yieldRecipient().notice: The address that receives yield generated by the yield vault.The owner collects generated yield, while the yield recipient receives it.

yieldVault().notice: An external, ERC-4246 compatible vault into which the underlying token is deposited to generate yield.
